'''Emeritus Chair''' was a high-ranking position in academia. After his discovery of the famed treasure of the ''[[Queen of Ranroon/Legends|Queen of Ranroon]]'', [[S. V. Skynx/Legends|S. V. Skynx]] was named Emeritus Chair of the [[University of Ruuria/Legends|University of Ruuria's]] [[Department of History]].
